News

News

  • Passenger Air Service - Survey Query

    20 Mar 2024, 3:06 pm

    The Times-Age asked for comment on discussions with Air Chathams and the nature of any possible financial input from the Council.

  • Civic Facility Project - Meeting Update

    14 Dec 2023, 2:19 pm

    The Times-Age asked for decisions regarding the civic facility project made by the Council at its meeting on 13 December.

  • Wairarapa Times-Age Query - Potholes

    10 Nov 2023, 8:23 am

    The Times-Age asked a series of questions about potholes in the Masterton district

  • Park Street Closed for Cultural Festival

    18 Sep 2023, 12:00 am

    The Times-Age asked for comment after a retailer raised concern about the impact (on business and parking) of closing Park Street on Saturday 9 September for the Cultural Festival.

  • Masterton District Council receives governance report

    15 Jun 2026, 10:36 am

    Masterton District Council has received a report commissioned by the three Wairarapa councils exploring the feasibility of a Wairarapa unitary authority.

  • Spruce-up for CBD through Town Centre Improvement Fund 

    11 Jun 2026, 3:00 pm

    A total of 11 Queen Street businesses have been approved for funding support from Masterton District Council to cover up to 80 percent of the cost of improving the look of their buildings.

  • Average 4.2% rates rise agreed following savings, service adjustments

    10 Jun 2026, 3:14 pm

    Following robust discussion at an extraordinary Council meeting, elected members have agreed to reduce the proposed rates increase to 4.2 percent for the next financial year.

  • Wairarapa history brought to life as 1940s newspapers go digital

    10 Jun 2026, 1:10 pm

    Around 1700 editions of the Wairarapa Times-Age from 1944 to1950 are now accessible online as part of the National Library of New Zealand’s Collaborative Newspaper Digitisation Programme.
